title: Brother Sun, Sister Moon
writer: Suso Cecchi D'Amico, Charles Dyer, Kenneth Ross
actors: Graham Faulkner, Judi Bowker, Leigh Lawson
plot: Dramatization of events in the life of St. Francis of Assisi from before his conversion experience through his audience with the pope, including his friendship with St. Clare.
awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 3 wins & 2 nominations total
